column1: # @trace order:1956-ucix, order:1954-xy5m (spec: openspec/changes/studio-asset-pipeline, design D9, not yet archived)
# THE CORRIDORKEY 2.0 WEIGHT MANIFEST, read by crates/tillandsias-headless/src/studio_key.rs.
# One row per FILE infer.py needs, pinned by publisher revision, sha256 and size.
# NONE of these files is ever baked into an image or redistributed by Tillandsias:
# they are fetched on the user's own machine, through the licence consent gate of
# order 1956-ecpb (design D6), into the shared model cache at
# which the container sees read-only as /models/corridorkey/<file>. The image
# which is exactly where upstream's RuntimePaths.from_package looks (hard-coded
# package-relative paths; no environment variable selects them).
#   repo        publisher repository (Hugging Face id, or the GitHub project for RVM)
#   revision    the publisher's pinned revision (a commit sha; RVM has none and
#               carries the publisher's md5 instead, as upstream verifies it)
#   file        the path under /models/corridorkey/ — upstream's package-relative path
#   licence     licence id (corridor-key-licence-2.0 is a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 variant
#               and RESTRICTED; the restricted register of 1956-ecpb carries its terms)
#   source      where the user's machine fetches it from
# Pinned from upstream scripts/download_weights.py at commit
# trees on 2026-11-02. The C-RADIO snapshot needs its config and the
# trust_remote_code modules beside model.safetensors (foundations.py loads the
# directory with local_files_only=True), so every file of that snapshot is a row.
